energieplan.name: Energy plan
energieplan.description: Let Home Assistant carry out the plan from the web app. Pick the entity of your battery integration that sets the power.

data.ems_vermogen: Entity that sets the battery power (W)
data.ems_netdoel: This entity is a grid target (like the grid setpoint of a Victron ESS)
data.ems_laden_positief: For this entity a positive number means charging

data_description.ems_vermogen: Positive means discharging, unless you flip it below.
data_description.ems_modus_sturen: For example the option that puts the battery in external control. Leave empty if not needed.
data_description.ems_max_laad_w: Empty or 0: the maximum from the plan.
